tools.name: add_element
tools.description: Add one element (text box, rectangle, ellipse, line, or image) to a slide. Lines draw from the top-left to the bottom-right corner of their bounding box. Returns the new element id.

slideId.description: Target slide id; defaults to the slide open in the editor.

x.description: Slide units; the canvas is 960 wide x 540 tall, origin at the top-left.

z.description: Stacking order; higher renders on top.

text.description: Text elements only. Use \n for line breaks.

fontFamily.description: Font stack, or a theme token: 'theme.heading' / 'theme.body'. Prefer tokens.

color.description: CSS color (e.g. '#0f172a') or a theme token: 'theme.background', 'theme.surface', 'theme.text', 'theme.accent', 'theme.accentText'. Prefer tokens so the deck restyles when the theme changes.

fill.description: CSS color (e.g. '#0f172a') or a theme token: 'theme.background', 'theme.surface', 'theme.text', 'theme.accent', 'theme.accentText'. Prefer tokens so the deck restyles when the theme changes.

stroke.description: CSS color (e.g. '#0f172a') or a theme token: 'theme.background', 'theme.surface', 'theme.text', 'theme.accent', 'theme.accentText'. Prefer tokens so the deck restyles when the theme changes.

src.description: Image URL, or 'placeholder' for a styled placeholder block.

tools.name: add_slide
tools.description: Insert a new slide from a layout. 'title' = centered title + subtitle; 'title-body' = heading + body text; 'two-col' = heading + two text columns (body fills the left, right starts empty); 'blank' = empty. Returns the new slide id and its element ids so you can refine them with update_element.

body.description: Body text. Use \n for line breaks, • for bullets.

position.description: 1-based position to insert at; defaults to the end of the deck.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the shopper's cart by SKU (from search_products results). Returns the updated cart so you can confirm the running total.

tools.name: align_elements
tools.description: Align elements to the slide or to their shared bounding box, and/or space them evenly along an axis (distribute needs 3+ elements; the first/last stay put). Same shape as align_selection. Returns the new positions.

distribute.description: Space the elements evenly along this axis; needs 3+ elements.

relativeTo.description: Default 'slide'. 'selection-bounds' aligns within the group's own bounding box.

tools.name: apply_preset
tools.description: Apply a complete built-in preset, replacing theme tokens. Call get_theme_overview to list preset ids.

tools.name: apply_promo
tools.description: Apply a promo code to the cart (e.g. TRAIL10, TRAILVIP, SUMMIT20). Returns whether it was accepted and the updated cart with the discount applied.

tools.name: apply_theme
tools.description: Switch the deck's theme. Every element using theme tokens ('theme.accent', 'theme.heading', …) restyles across ALL slides.

tools.name: assign_color_role
tools.description: Recolor a widget region by role, palette family, and intensity.

tools.name: check_contrast
tools.description: Run WCAG checks over key text/background pairs.

tools.name: configure_widget
tools.description: Toggle launcher position, feature flags, and message layout.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event and render it on the page. startDate/endDate are LOCAL wall-clock times in the calendar timezone, formatted YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm: never append "Z" or a UTC offset (any offset is ignored and the stated clock time is used as-is). Use a userId from get_calendar_state.

startDate.description: Event start as local wall-clock time, e.g. 2026-06-11T08:00. No "Z" or UTC offset.

endDate.description: Event end as local wall-clock time, e.g. 2026-06-11T09:00. No "Z" or UTC offset.

tools.name: delete_elements
tools.description: Permanently remove one or more elements by id.

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Delete an event from the calendar by eventId.

tools.name: delete_slide
tools.description: Permanently remove a slide and all its elements.

tools.name: duplicate_slide
tools.description: Copy a slide (and all its elements) right after the original. Returns the new slide id.

position.description: 1-based position of the slide to copy.

tools.name: enter_presenter_mode
tools.description: Enter full-screen presenter mode. NOTE: this replaces your editing tools with presentation controls (next_slide, prev_slide, jump_to_slide, exit_presenter_mode) until the show ends.

position.description: 1-based slide to start from; defaults to slide 1.

tools.name: find_availability
tools.description: Find open slots on a date, optionally for a single user. Workday is 9am-5pm local time. Returned slot times are local wall-clock times in the calendar timezone.

tools.name: get_calendar_state
tools.description: Read the current calendar state: current local date-time, selected date, visible week, timezone, total event count, visible events, and the valid users (with the userIds create_event accepts). Call this before creating or editing events. All event times are local wall-clock times in the calendar timezone.

tools.name: get_deck_overview
tools.description: Read the deck: title, active theme, slide count, and per-slide {id, position, title, elementCount}. Call this first to orient yourself; positions are 1-based.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: List calendar events. Optionally filter by month in YYYY-MM format, userId, or a text search over title/description/location.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Read the elements the user currently has selected on the canvas: ids, types, geometry, and styles. Use this whenever the user says 'this', 'these', or refers to something they clicked.

tools.name: get_slide
tools.description: Read one slide's full contents: every element with its id, geometry, and style. Call this before editing a slide's elements. Defaults to the slide open in the editor.

tools.name: get_theme_overview
tools.description: Read theme summary, presets, and editable levers. Call before editing.

tools.name: goto_slide
tools.description: Open a slide in the editor (navigation only: changes nothing).

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List the available deck themes with their palettes and fonts.

tools.name: manage_session
tools.description: Undo, redo, reset defaults, or export the theme snapshot.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.description: Remove a product from the cart by SKU, or reduce its quantity. Omit quantity to remove the line entirely. Returns the updated cart.

tools.name: reorder_slides
tools.description: Move a slide to a new 1-based position. Returns the resulting slide order.

tools.name: screenshot_preview
tools.description: Capture the current rendered state of the theme preview as an image: exactly what the user sees. Returns one JPEG per visible preview frame (two when a compare mode is active, labeled e.g. Light/Dark). Call after applying a batch of theme changes to verify the visual result, especially when matching a reference image.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalog by free-text query (e.g. 'waterproof trail shoe', 'blue running', 'jacket'). Returns matching products with SKU, title, brand, color, price, imageUrl, and imageAlt.

tools.name: select_date
tools.description: Move the calendar UI to a specific date without creating an event.

tools.name: set_brand_colors
tools.description: Set primary, secondary, and/or accent colors. Generates shade scales and accepts hex, rgb/rgba, or CSS names.

tools.name: set_color_scheme
tools.description: Set light/dark/auto color scheme and optional edit target.

tools.name: set_copy_and_suggestions
tools.description: Set welcome copy, input placeholder, send label, and suggestion chips.

tools.name: set_deck_title
tools.description: Set the deck's title.

tools.name: set_roundness
tools.description: Set roundness by style or granular radius values.

radius.description: Granular px or CSS length overrides.

tools.name: set_slide_props
tools.description: Update a slide's title and/or background color.

background.description: CSS color (e.g. '#0f172a') or a theme token: 'theme.background', 'theme.surface', 'theme.text', 'theme.accent', 'theme.accentText'. Prefer tokens so the deck restyles when the theme changes.

tools.name: set_theme_fields
tools.description: Advanced escape hatch: set fields by id or raw dot-path. Values are validated when metadata exists.

tools.name: set_typography
tools.description: Set font family, size, weight, and line height.

tools.name: update_element
tools.description: Merge a partial patch into one element: position, size, text, and style in a single call. Omitted keys are unchanged. Returns the updated element.

patch.description: Partial element properties to merge; omitted keys are unchanged.

x.description: Slide units; the canvas is 960 wide x 540 tall, origin at the top-left.

z.description: Stacking order; higher renders on top.

text.description: Text elements only. Use \n for line breaks.

fontFamily.description: Font stack, or a theme token: 'theme.heading' / 'theme.body'. Prefer tokens.

color.description: CSS color (e.g. '#0f172a') or a theme token: 'theme.background', 'theme.surface', 'theme.text', 'theme.accent', 'theme.accentText'. Prefer tokens so the deck restyles when the theme changes.

fill.description: CSS color (e.g. '#0f172a') or a theme token: 'theme.background', 'theme.surface', 'theme.text', 'theme.accent', 'theme.accentText'. Prefer tokens so the deck restyles when the theme changes.

stroke.description: CSS color (e.g. '#0f172a') or a theme token: 'theme.background', 'theme.surface', 'theme.text', 'theme.accent', 'theme.accentText'. Prefer tokens so the deck restyles when the theme changes.

src.description: Image URL, or 'placeholder' for a styled placeholder block.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Update an existing event by eventId. Only supplied fields are changed. startDate/endDate are LOCAL wall-clock times (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, no "Z" or UTC offset).

startDate.description: Local wall-clock time, e.g. 2026-06-11T08:00. No "Z" or UTC offset.

endDate.description: Local wall-clock time, e.g. 2026-06-11T09:00. No "Z" or UTC offset.

tools.name: view_product
tools.description: Look at one product in detail by SKU (from search_products results). Highlights it on the page and returns its full description plus imageUrl/imageAlt. Read-only.
